title: Practice 4: Accusative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Catherine wanted to go to the shopping center.
exercises.why: Я поехал в музей.* Adjectives change to fit the noun they modify, taking on their noun's gender, number, and case. This also includes animation: adjectives modifying inanimate masculine nouns keep their nominative form (**ый**, **ий**, and **ой**), while animate masculine adjectives take on their genitive form (**ого** and **его**). Neuter adjectives also keep their nominative form (**ое** and **ее**). Feminine adjectives in the accusative case have the ending (**ую** and **юю**) - this is easy to remember, as it's the two endings of feminine nouns in the accusative.* — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
exercises.context: Я поехал в музей.
